sentences.text:
Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J.
------
For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Manoj Kr. Sah, Advocate.
For the State : Mrs. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P.

The petitioner, who is an accused for the offence punishable  Section(s) 366A of the Indian Penal Code, cognizance has been taken under Section 366, 376(2)(n)
IPC as well as Section 6 of the POCSO Act, is praying for grant of regular bail.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
The victim is aged about 17 years and four days at the time of occurrence.

She states that she herself had gone with this petitioner, aged about 20 years, and they solemnized their marriage and started staying in Ludhiana and thereafter, they came to Delhi and resided there.
The aforesaid fact is reflected in the impugned order, whereby the prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected.

This statement was given by the victim in the her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
Learned A.P.P opposes the prayer for bail.
In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to allow this application.

Accordingly, the petitioner,
above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. District &
Sessions Judge, 1 st -cum- Special Judge (POCSO) Godda, in connection with POCSO Case No. 07/2024, arising out of Godda (Muffasil) P.S. Case No. 152 of 2023.
